name: sonos-local
title: Sonos Local
description: Control Sonos speakers on your local network over UPnP, with no cloud account and no login.
author: blacktakeover

commands.name: sonos
commands.title: Control Sonos
commands.description: Browse rooms and groups with the current track and control playback

commands.name: group
commands.title: Group Speakers
commands.description: Add speakers to the active group or remove them

commands.name: play-pause
commands.title: Play or Pause
commands.description: Play or pause the active group

commands.name: volume-up
commands.title: Raise Volume
commands.description: Raise the volume of the active group

commands.name: volume-down
commands.title: Lower Volume
commands.description: Lower the volume of the active group

preferences.name: host
preferences.title: Speaker IP
preferences.description: IP address of any speaker. Leave empty to discover speakers automatically.

preferences.name: defaultRoom
preferences.title: Default Room
preferences.description: Room the quick commands control when nothing is playing.

preferences.name: volumeStep
preferences.title: Volume Step
preferences.description: How much Raise Volume and Lower Volume change the volume.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
